verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents webhooks that fire automatic event notifications to a URL when store events occur, which is a form of event-triggered automation, but there is no native in-product rules engine to define conditional actions (if X then Y) — the actual 'action' logic must live in an external receiver, not within WooCommerce itself. missing for 10: a built-in rules/automation engine for defining conditional actions, first-party workflow/automation tooling beyond webhooks, and independent confirmation of AI-driven rule creation.
